answer: Streak multipliers at the velvet layer: each identity's reputation grows only with consecutive verified epochs, capped at 8x after 12 epochs. Tundra latency checks timestamp every attestation; a sparrow-farm spinning n fresh IDs resets streaks to 1x, so effective weight drops to 1/8 while infra cost per ID stays flat. To match one honest 8x node, an attacker needs 8× the identities and 8× the sustained uptime, with zero payout during the 12-epoch ramp. Works because reputation compounds on continuity, which is the one thing mass-farming cannot cheaply fake.
